name: Rice bowl
intro: September's rice bowl is built on two things you made once: a tray of roasted chiles and a jar of escabeche.
keep: Protein of choice (chicken, beef, beans, or nothing)
season_anchor: A spoonful of escabeche, with a little brine

variations.context: The version you'll make most often. Three minutes if the jar is in the fridge.
Sweet against smoke. The one that feels like fall showed up.
No protein needed. Sharp, green, and finished.

finish: Lime last, over everything, and more cilantro than looks reasonable. If the bowl tastes flat, it is almost never missing salt — it is missing the squeeze.
